### 1) What is on the screen
The frame is a tall narrow list on solid black: white pixel text names with a small standing humanoid sprite under each — AFTER ZEUS 1 with blue sprite, KRONOS with orange sprite, LT. PE with blue sprite, PERCY with blue sprite three times in a row, OURANO with grey sprite at the bottom, all cropped on the right edge. The eye goes first to the orange KRONOS sprite around region x,y,w,h 48,185,60,75 because it is the only warm colour in a column of blue. I cannot see gameplay, level, HUD, scroll, or what the player is being asked to do — this reads as a roster / credit roll, not play.

### 2) Does it look like a real NES game
(a) PASS — palette count reads as NES: measured 11 distinct colours vs hardware ceiling “at most 25 colours on screen at once”, all measured as NES palette entries, 84.1% one colour black backdrop as expected. 
(b) PASS — shading is flat, one colour per shape: sprites use 2-3 flat blocks, no gradient banding, consistent with “no gradients”.
(c) PASS — sprites read at a glance: blue / orange / grey bodies on black $0F backdrop have clear 8x8-style silhouettes, no muddy shared colours with background.
(d) PASS — no anti-aliasing and no soft edges: text and sprites are hard block pixels, including window borders — there are none to blur — per “no anti-aliasing”.
(e) PASS — background colour changes: there are none, only shared backdrop black, so no violation of “a background can change palette only on a 16 x 16 pixel boundary”. Measured numbers do not contradict impression, but size does: measured 168 x 936 is not “256 x 240 pixels”, so this file as presented cannot be a real NES output frame.

### 3) Composition and text
The column is 85%+ empty black with large voids between entries, no crowding except text touching the right edge; the focal orange sprite is mid-top, not where a player prompt would need to be, and there is no prompt to anchor the eye. Text regions: [16,10,140,50] AFTER ZEUS 1 clipped on the 1, [16,145,140,35] KRONOS legible, [16,305,140,35] LT. PE, [16,450,140,35] PERCY, [16,580,140,35] PERCY, [16,710,140,35] PERCY, [16,815,140,35] OURANO. Worst is [16,305,140,35] LT. PE and [16,815,140,35] OURANO — both truncated off the right side of the 168-pixel image, so at 256 x 240 they would be guessing, not reading, and the 3x pixels make the 8x8 glyph grid look cut mid-tile.

### 4) What looks AI generated or off
No pillow shading, no gradient mush, no fake glyphs — this looks handmade and honest pixel work, not AI painterly. What is off is presentation as design: right-edge truncation on three text rows is not a whole number of tiles, repeated PERCY x3 with identical blue sprite reads as a data dump / prompt list instead of a designed screen, and the extreme 168 x 936 portrait strip with 84.1% black reads as a cropped capture, not a 256 x 240 composition. No stray AA pixels, but the crop is the blunt failure.

### 5) Five concrete fixes
1. Region [16,10,140,50] AFTER ZEUS 1 clipped: redraw the whole row 16 pixels left (2 tiles) in 8x8 white $30 on backdrop $0F black so the final “1” is fully inside.
2. Region [16,305,140,35] LT. PE truncated: move left by 16 pixels and redraw complete as “LT. PERCY” in same font, white $30, no new colours.
3. Region [8,430,152,40] dead black gap between entries: move all rows below up by 32 pixels (4 tiles) to cut empty backdrop and bring strip closer to 240-high rhythm.
4. Region [48,860,60,70] OURANO grey sprite kissing bottom edge: move sprite + text up by 16 pixels (1 attribute row / 2 tiles) to leave 16-pixel black margin, keep grey as NES $00 + $10 + $30 white.
5. Region [48,185,60,75] KRONOS orange sprite: keep to one “4 sprite palettes of 4 entries (3 colours plus transparency)” — replace pale highlight with NES $28 yellow, body NES $27 orange, outline $0F black — and simplify 1-pixel dither on chest to flat.

### 6) Scores and machine readable block
nes_authenticity: 7/10 - colours and flat tiles are right, size/crop is not 256x240
readability: 5/10 - sprites clear, two text rows truncated
charm: 4/10 - honest but repetitive list on void
